limits: Series 11 46mm simulator running watchOS 26.4, not the user physical Series 12 / OS27.
All probes active, visible, monitoring, wristDown false, reduceMotion false, lowPower false. Quiet/Always-On states were not exercised.
Six static screenshots verify layout placement only, not every clip, gestures, audio, installation or animation quality. Default 3s and 8s images are identical.
Theater/activity screenshots have no bottom ellipsis; entry-point reachability was not tested here.
Anchor denotes placement baseline, not anatomical foot when a cushion is present.
